control.description-key: Log application insights to your Microsoft Clarity account

event.name: OnEventPosting
event.description-key: Behavior run when an event is successfully posted to Clarity
event.pfx-default-value: Trace("Custom event posted to Microsoft Clarity", TraceSeverity.Information, {Message:_ClarityEventMessage}); UpdateContext({_ClarityEventMessage: ""});

event.name: OnTagsPosting
event.description-key: Behavior run when an session tags are successfully posted to Clarity
event.pfx-default-value: Trace("Session tags posted to Microsoft Clarity", TraceSeverity.Information, {Tags:_ClaritySessionTags}); With({wthSessionTagsTableSchema: Table({Key: "", Value: ""})}, ClearCollect(_ClaritySessionTags, Filter(Table(wthSessionTagsTableSchema, _ClaritySessionTags), And(!IsBlank(ThisRecord.Key), !IsBlank(ThisRecord.Value)))));

property.name: ClarityStatus
property.description-key: The status of the Microsoft Clarity instance

property.name: ClarityProjectId
property.description-key: The ID of the Clarity project used to log events and sessions

property.name: SessionId
property.description-key: The session id to associate to this session [Default: Host.SessionID]

property.name: UserId
property.description-key: The user id to associate to this session [Default: User().Email]

property.name: UserName
property.description-key: The user name to associate to this session [Default: User().FullName]

property.name: ConsentGranted
property.description-key: Has consent has been granted to record this session [Default: false]

property.name: PrioritizeSession
property.description-key: Prioritize this session for recording/retention [Default: false]

property.name: CustomEvent
property.description-key: A custom event message to tag to this session

property.name: CustomTags
property.description-key: A set of custom tags to add to this session
